title.zh: Binance now lets users turn stocks into on-chain tokens
title.en: Binance now lets users turn stocks into on-chain tokens

current_state.zh: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
current_state.en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.

updates.title_zh: 币安现允许用户将股票转换为链上代币
updates.title_en: Binance now lets users turn stocks into on-chain tokens
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Crypto News 报道，币安推出了一项新功能，允许用户将股票转换为链上代币。此举将币安的现实世界资产（RWA）代币化业务扩展至股票领域。

币安是按交易量计全球最大的加密货币交易所，将股票纳入其现实世界资产代币化产品线，意味着链上资产敞口通过现有主流交易平台延伸至新的资产类别。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.

updates.current_state_en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.background_zh: 据 Chainlink 的科普解释，代币化股票是基于区块链的代币，代表上市公司的股份，并设计为追踪标的股票的价格。其他平台也已进入这一领域：Kraken 通过其 xStocks 产品提供代币化股票和 ETF，Robinhood Chain 则在链上追踪代币化股票。
updates.background_en: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that represent shares of publicly traded companies and are designed to mirror the price of the underlying stock, per Chainlink's explainer. Other venues have pursued the same segment: Kraken offers tokenized stocks and ETFs through its xStocks product, and Robinhood Chain tracks tokenized equities on-chain.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若该功能形成规模，股票敞口将通过币安的交易与托管通道转化为链上代币，使 RWA 代币板块以及交易所对证券类挂钩产品的处理方式进入关注范围。其传导渠道主要在于托管安排与代币化股票的监管定性，而非特定代币的供应量变化。
updates.market_impact_en: If the feature operates at scale, equity exposure would flow into on-chain tokens through Binance's trading and custody rails, putting the RWA token segment and the exchange's handling of securities-linked products in scope. The transmission channel runs through custody arrangements and the regulatory treatment of tokenized equities rather than through any specific token supply change.
